title: Concept: Internal cache key exposed
description: A cache key that encodes the tenant and the subject in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The key shows the naming scheme of the cache, which is what an attacker needs to poison an entry or to guess keys that belong to another customer.
applicability: Deployments that render a cache key that encodes the tenant and the subject into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The key shows the naming scheme of the cache, which is what an attacker needs to poison an entry or to guess keys that belong to another customer.
